name: stat
title: Stat
description: A big bold number with a small uppercase tracked unit and optional delta + sparkline. Warp signature primitive. v0.10 — Satoshi-only; tabular alignment via OpenType tnum, not a separate mono face. v0.11.17 — sparkline is fluid (preferred max width, scales to fit tight columns) and right-anchored via ml-auto; StatGrid `divided` divider is a gap-centred pseudo-element so all columns share equal content area.
